notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב em i bel — tingting na laik — i no hat

notes.subject: ואנש
notes.rationale: Sipela i no gat wanpela mining: 'i no inap beten' (ylt), 'worspela tru' (kjv), 'i no gat strong' (jps)

notes.subject: עקב
notes.rationale: עקב em i nem bilong 'het bilong fut' na 'giaman' olsem Yakov — tupela mining i lus long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: husat i save long em?
notes.rationale: Tok i askim — narapela man i no inap save long bel; tasol Yahwe long ves 10

translation: Bel i save giaman tru, i winim olgeta samting, na em i no inap kisim beten — husat i save long em?

tokens.gloss: na em i no inap kisim beten
